consumerClasses.behavior: Preserve the namespaced value as opaque JSON. Never interpret it and never claim Runtime Authority conformance.
Require the namespaced value at every run and receipt authority boundary; validate, verify, and exact-match it against trusted state or fail closed.

changeClasses.behavior: The existing spec/coven-automations/v1 tree is frozen for this slice. Authority evolution must not rewrite or relabel its historical artifact.
Closed schemas reject unknown fields. Additions require a new companion profile.
Changes to required anchors, validation, freshness, replay, or refusal behavior require a new companion profile.
A generic base-v1 consumer may preserve an authority value it does not understand, but preservation conveys no authority conformance.
